faq.title: A few things before you start.

stack.question: What is it built with?
stack.answer: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, with Postgres for data.

payments.question: Can I switch payment providers?
payments.answer: Choose Creem, Stripe, Lemon Squeezy or Waffo Pancake through configuration. Set up the matching products and webhooks when switching; existing subscriptions are not migrated automatically.

customize.question: How do I build my own features?
customize.answer: Configure branding, pages and plans, then write features in the business directory using the shared auth, credits and AI interfaces. The starter guide includes examples.

license.question: Can I use it for commercial projects?
license.answer: Yes. Personal and commercial use are both covered.

fit.question: Which projects is this for?
fit.answer: AI tools that need authentication, payments and credit billing. Team collaboration and multi-tenancy require additional development.

services.question: Which external services do I need?
services.answer: Deployment needs a database and email service. Configure payments, AI models, object storage and rate limiting for the features you enable. Local development supports substitutes.

deliverables.question: What exactly do I get?
deliverables.answer: The complete source (auth, payments, credits, AI and admin), the starter guide and business examples. Your download link is emailed right after payment, and you can sign in to your downloads page any time.

costs.question: Are there any other costs?
costs.answer: The template is a one-time purchase. Neon, Resend and Vercel all have free tiers that usually cover the early days; AI models are billed per use by your model provider.

updates.question: How long do I get updates?
updates.answer: Every release within one year of purchase is included and appears on your downloads page, with email support during that time. After that, the releases you already have stay downloadable and keep working.

refund.question: Can I get a refund?
refund.answer: No. The template is a digital product that can’t be returned once delivered, so all sales are final. Try the demo and read the docs before buying; contact us about duplicate or unauthorized charges.
